## About
Cisco's Auto Check Service & Sales is family owned and operated by Cisco Trujillo, an ASE Certified Master Technician. He opened the shop to go against the old idea of the shady mechanic and to give every customer honest, careful work.
We follow the maintenance recommendations in your owner's manual, so small issues get caught before they turn into big repair bills. We also like to explain what we see, so you can make informed choices about your car.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 83 Google reviews. We work on all kinds of makes and models, foreign and domestic, and we'd be glad to take a look at yours.

## Services
- Oil changes, brake inspections and tire rotations: Oil changes, brake inspections, battery checks, tire rotations and fluid top-ups.
- Engine, transmission and brake repair: When something isn't working right, we track down the problem and replace worn or failing parts.
- Diagnostics, electrical and air conditioning: Engine diagnostics to find underlying problems, plus electrical repairs and air conditioning service.
- Exhaust and suspension work: Exhaust system service and suspension work to keep your car riding safe and quiet.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: Very likely. We service foreign and domestic cars, including Toyota, Nissan, Mercedes-Benz, Lexus, Honda, Ford, Dodge, Chevrolet and BMW.

Q: How do you decide what maintenance my car needs?
A: We follow the recommendations in your vehicle's owner's manual, which helps prevent major repairs and unexpected costs later.

Q: How do I request service?
A: Give us a call at the shop, email us, or send a service request through the form on our website.
